description: Return account-wide scan rollups across all of the signed-in user's codes, not a single code. Use this for totals, trends, and plan-level performance over a date range ("how did all my codes do last week?"). Use get_qr_analytics when the question is about one code, get_plan for limits and remaining credits, and list_dynamic_qrs to see the codes themselves. `range` is a named window unless `from` and `to` (ISO-8601 dates) are set. `granularity` controls bucket size. `compare` adds the previous period when true. Returned fields are plan-dependent.

compare.description: Include the previous period when true

from.description: ISO-8601 start date for a custom range

range.description: Named date window unless from and to are set

to.description: ISO-8601 end date for a custom range

name: get_account_analytics
title: Account stats
